phase_name: Expanded Regression Suite & Final Staging Gate
summary: All 144 offline application regression tests passed with zero failures and zero regressions. Frontend Next.js Turbopack build passed cleanly with 15/15 static pages and 0 TypeScript errors. Static code analysis passed with 0 ruff errors. No critical or high application-level security vulnerabilities remain. However, live infrastructure tests (17 tests) were withheld due to the strict machine safety threshold (available physical RAM is 520 MB < 2048 MB required), and operational original file binary backup must be paired with database dumps before production cutover.

live_infrastructure_gate.closure_condition: Execute integration suite on a runner or host with >= 2048 MB available physical memory

raw_file_persistence_backup.note: PostgreSQL pg_dump restores text and metadata; local storage volume (STORAGE_PATH) or S3 bucket must have independent snapshot/replication enabled to restore original PDF/DOCX/image binaries.
